projects.title: Course Project on Product-Review Classification
bullets: Cleaned public product-review text records and implemented a bag-of-words classifier using Python, pandas, and scikit-learn for a supervised undergraduate course project.
Compared classification errors across document lengths as an assigned contribution to the student team's analysis.

research.title: Question-Category Text Classification
bullets: Implemented a bag-of-words classifier for short public question-category documents using Python and scikit-learn as a supervised student research assistant.
Compared classification errors across document lengths in public question-category text within the supervised research work.

research.title: River-Level Time Series Forecasting
bullets: Aligned public river-level sensor time series using Python and pandas as a student research assistant working under faculty supervision.
Implemented a seasonal baseline for forecasting from public river-level measurement series within the supervised research project.
